title: Two verdicts: a bad report's core is cleared
summary: The extrinsic brings one verdict that a report is good and one that another is bad. The bad report is pending availability on a core, so that core is cleared and the report will not be accumulated. The guarantors of the bad report (culprits) and a validator who judged the good report invalid (a fault) become offenders.

rows.label: Verdict on report `0xa78b526a…`
cells: good: 5 of 5 judgments say valid (6 judges)

rows.label: Verdict on report `0xf9076864…`
cells: bad: 0 of 5 judgments say valid (6 judges)

params: the tiny chain the v0.8.0 vectors were made with ($\mathsf{E}$ = 12 slots per epoch, $\mathsf{Y}$ = 10, $\mathsf{C}$ = 2 cores, 6 validators)
notes: A verdict needs $\lfloor 2/3 \cdot 6 \rfloor + 1$ = 5 judgments. All valid makes it good, none valid bad. The report of a pending core is matched by the hash of its encoding.
